## Load Data

```{r}
#| label: libraries
#| message: FALSE

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")}

if (!requireNamespace("GEOquery", quietly = TRUE)) {
  BiocManager::install("GEOquery")}

library(GEOquery)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: AccessData
#| echo: FALSE

options(timeout = 600)

#Retrieves the MicroArray Device information data from NCBI GEO 
GPL11012 <- getGEO("GPL11012")

#Extracts tabular data (microarray annotation table)
annotation <- Table(GPL11012)
dim(annotation)

#Download the supplementary raw microarray data files to process (tar file)
download.file(
  url = "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE24nnn/GSE24504/suppl/GSE24504_RAW.tar",
  destfile = "../data/_raw/GSE24504_RAW.tar",
  mode = "wb"
)

untar(
  tarfile = "../data/_raw/GSE24504_RAW.tar",
  exdir = "../data/_raw/GSE24504_RAW"
)

```
